package.title: GLM：公開・ローカル展開からARCと長文脈servingへ
package.purpose: ChatGLM-6Bのconsumer deploymentと権利境界、GLM-4 All Tools、GLM-4.5のARC/MoE、GLM-5.2の長文脈効率・servingを一つのversion-specific lineageとして追う。
must_cover_requirements: ChatGLM-6Bのweight/commercial permissionsとrepository code licensingを混同しない。
GLM-4 All ToolsからGLM-4.5 ARCへのagentic strategyの変化をversion名付きで説明する。
GLM-5.2のIndexShare、1M context、serving path、効率値はmodel-card/vendor claimとして条件付きで扱う。
boundaries: GLM-4.5 ARC framing is family/version-specific and is not generalized into a common Chinese-model training recipe.
Vendor efficiency figures remain source- and condition-bound rather than independent cross-family performance facts.
Model-weight/commercial permissions and repository-code licensing must not be collapsed into one license label.
Benchmark results in the paper are author evaluations and must not be merged into an incompatible cross-family ranking.
The ARC framing and reported architecture are specific to GLM-4.5 and are not evidence of a shared Chinese-model training recipe.
Efficiency numbers remain model-card/vendor claims and associated repository-code licensing may differ from model-artifact licensing.

sources.title: ChatGLM-6B
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The project documents ChatGLM-6B as a 6.2B bilingual dialogue model with an INT4 consumer-GPU deployment path reporting about 6GB of memory use.
The historical model-use regime separated academic openness from an additional commercial-use permission path, while repository code licensing is a distinct subject.

limitations.text: Model-weight/commercial permissions and repository-code licensing must not be collapsed into one license label.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify ChatGLM-6B local-deployment requirements and distinguish weight/commercial permissions from repository-code licensing.
targets.finding: The repository documents the INT4 local-deployment path and a model-use regime with additional commercial permission, distinct from repository code licensing.

sources.title: ChatGLM family report / GLM-4 All Tools
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The family report reconstructs the GLM lineage through GLM-4, GLM-4-Air and GLM-4-9B and describes multi-stage post-training after roughly ten trillion pretraining tokens.
The report describes GLM-4 All Tools as autonomously choosing among web browsing, Python, text-to-image and user-defined functions.

limitations.text: Benchmark results in the paper are author evaluations and must not be merged into an incompatible cross-family ranking.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify GLM-4 family composition, training/post-training description, open releases, and All Tools behavior from the paper.
targets.finding: The primary family report directly covers GLM-4 family composition, training/post-training, open GLM-4 releases, and All Tools behavior.

sources.title: GLM-4.5 ARC
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The GLM-4.5 paper describes a 355B-total/32B-active MoE model family with hybrid thinking/direct response and explicitly frames the foundation model around Agentic, Reasoning and Coding (ARC).

limitations.text: The ARC framing and reported architecture are specific to GLM-4.5 and are not evidence of a shared Chinese-model training recipe.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify GLM-4.5 architecture, MoE design, and ARC positioning from the primary paper.
targets.finding: The paper directly describes the MoE design and explicit ARC positioning.

sources.title: GLM-5.2
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The official GLM-5.2 model card documents 1M context, flexible thinking effort, and IndexShare cross-layer sparse-attention index reuse.
The model card reports a 2.9x per-token FLOP reduction at 1M context for the named efficiency mechanism and documents vLLM/SGLang deployment plus MIT model-license metadata.
claims.context: Vendor/model-card claims; no independent reproduction implied.

limitations.text: Efficiency numbers remain model-card/vendor claims and associated repository-code licensing may differ from model-artifact licensing.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
